# INTEGRATION_TEST_llaudio_parity scene script (generated by make_llaudio_parity_scenes.py).
#
# Each scene runs on a fresh engine opened on a null device at 2, 6 and 8
# output channels, 44100 Hz; the frame clock starts at 1000 s and advances by
# the rendered frames. Commands:
#   sound <name> tone <hz> <s> <amp> | sweep <hz0> <hz1> <s> <amp> | noise <seed> <s> <amp>
#         | square <hz> <s> <amp> | clicks <period ms> <s> <amp> | dc <s> <amp>
#                       integer-synthesised 16-bit .dsf in the sound cache
#   scene <name> block=<frames> [stat] [channels=<n,...>]   renders in calls of at
#                       most <frames>; stat: compared as RMS per marked segment
#                       (noise); channels: only at these output channel counts
#   master <g> | mute <0|1> | secondary <type> <g> | doppler <f> | rolloff <f>
#   wind <0|1> | maxwind <g> | windvec <x y z> <camera altitude>
#                       the LLAudioEngine calls of the same names
#   listener <pos> <vel> <up> <at>        LLAudioEngine::setListener
#   source <name> engine|direct [gain=] [type=] [loop] [forced] [master] [slave] [queue]
#                       engine: added to the engine (LLAudioEngine::addAudioSource);
#                       direct: driven on its own channel below
#   pos <src> <x y z> <vx vy vz> | gain <src> <g> | loop <src> <0|1>
#   play <src> <sound> | stop <src>       LLAudioSource::play / stop
#   data <src> <sound>                    a direct source's current data and buffer
#   channel <ch> <src>                    a channel from LLAudioEngine::createChannel, setSource
#   chplay <ch> | chsynced <ch> <master> | chcleanup <ch>
#   chupdate <ch>       updateBuffer, update3DPosition, updateLoop (loop flag observed)
#   idle                LLAudioEngine::idle, then the observables are recorded
#   observe | commit | render <frames> | advance <s>
#   mark <label>        starts an RMS segment (stat scenes)
